bookSourceComment:
MangaBall (mangaball.com) - API-based comic source.
API: /api/v1/title/search-advanced, /title/recently-updated, /title/recently-added, /title/detail/<id>, /title/chapter-listing, /chapter-detail?chapter_id= (pages array).
adult_mode=all de bao gom truyen 18+. TOC uu tien vi, fallback en.
Images need Referer (chikorita host blocks otherwise) - set in source header.
